classification: New independent-source prospective study; never replaces frozen competition targets
input_cutoff: Previous UTC calendar day; observation and retrieval timestamps retained

target_definition.statistic: daily median across quality-ok AWS/Azure/GCP spot observations; SKU rate divided by GPU count
target_definition.source: Alex Hubbard independently retrieved CC BY4 archive
target_definition.gap_rule: No interpolation, forward fill or cross-series stitching
target_definition.revision_rule: First captured vintage preserved; later captures append revisions

candidate_pool: Exact 42 identifiers in frozen v2 registry, same implementations and explicit logged baseline fallbacks for unavailable auxiliaries; no candidates added
selector_scale: Frozen v2 training-only scale loaded from hash-verified derived archive; never estimated from prospective outcomes

scoring.pinball: Mean of q10/q50/q90 loss, then mean over exact matched cells
scoring.failures: Retain every failure; no implicit zero, no substitution for a failed policy; pairwise cohorts and missingness explicit
scoring.analysis_schedule: After each registered origin fully matures, descriptive cumulative results; final analysis after eight origins; no checkpoint/configuration reselection
scoring.independence: Weekly origins avoid overlapping target dates but share history and market regimes; cells are not independent
scoring.stopping: Eight origins or terminal source unavailability documented; no performance-based stopping

protected_dates.rule: Never download these price partitions or use observations on these dates

publication: Only independently licensed derived observations, forecasts, scores and provenance; raw source objects retained privately
existing_commitments: Unchanged; baseline and Chronos November16/18/22 remain locked in prospective_control_v3.py
